feeds.title: Young Lives vs Cancer » Children
feeds.description: Read the stories of children affected by cancer on Young Lives vs Cancer.It is the charity that helps children and young people and their families find the strength to face whatever cancer throws at them.

feeds.title: Kidscan Children's Cancer Research
feeds.description: Read the Kidscan blog for the latest news including children's cancer research updates to stories from our fundraisers, supporters, and charity ambassadors.Kidscan Children's Cancer Research is a Salford-based charity that funds and manages research into new and improved treatments for children with cancer.

feeds.title: Children's Cancer Research Fund
feeds.description: Get all the latest news from Friends of Rosie about their fundraising programs, charity events, research, and much more.Friends of Rosie is a volunteer-led charity that provides funding for children's cancer research to get new ideas off the ground. The research ideas they fund are right at the outset of medical thinking and innovation.

feeds.title: Neuroblastoma UK
feeds.description: Get the latest updates from Neuroblastoma UK, including fundraising stories, research news, and charity events.Neuroblastoma UK is a national charity, dedicated to finding a cure for neuroblastoma, an aggressive childhood cancer. They fund leading research to develop new, effective and kinder treatments for children with neuroblastoma.

feeds.title: Candlelighters
feeds.description: Here you'll find all the latest news about our fundraising adventures, inspirational stories, eye-opening research and much more!Candlelighters is a charity bringing light and hope to families facing childhood cancer across Yorkshire, providing emotional, practical and financial support from diagnosis and for as long as is needed, as well as funding research into childhood cancers.

feeds.title: Childhood Eye Cancer Trust Blog
feeds.description: Retinoblastoma news, research updates, and real life stories. The Childhood Eye Cancer Trust is a UK charity dedicated to helping people affected by retinoblastoma, a rare form of eye cancer. Their mission is to support people affected by retinoblastoma and to raise awareness of the signs and symptoms of the condition.

feeds.title: The Joshua Tree
feeds.description: News updates from The Joshua Tree. The Joshua Tree is a charity operating across the North West and North Wales dedicated to working closely with the families affected by childhood cancers.

feeds.title: PASIC
feeds.description: The latest news about events, and fundraising programs conducted to help the families of children and young people with cancer.PASIC provides emotional, social and practical support to families of children and young people with cancer living in the East Midlands to improve the quality of their lives. It is a lifeline to many during a traumatic and isolating time.

feeds.title: Children's Cancer North
feeds.description: Keep up to date with all the latest news from Children's Cancer North.It is an independent charity with over 40 years of heritage in supporting individuals and families affected by childhood cancer. They help kids to beat cancer and live long, happy and healthy lives.

feeds.title: Children with Cancer UK
feeds.description: Finding out that your child has cancer is devastating. Read the journeys of some of the many families affected by childhood cancer and how we support them. Children with Cancer UK is the leading national children's charity dedicated to the fight against childhood cancer.

feeds.title: Give A Duck
feeds.description: News and events updates about their charity work, chemo duck, and fund raising programs.The Give A Duck Foundation is a children's cancer charity, supporting local children who have been diagnosed with cancer throughout the UK.

feeds.title: Solving Kids' Cancer UK
feeds.description: News updates from Solving Kids' Cancer.Solving Kids' Cancer is an organization that helps families affected by high-risk childhood cancers through supporting access to treatment, funding research, parent education and raising awareness.

feeds.title: Children with Cancer Fund
feeds.description: The blog covers topics such as charity news, family events, stories, etc.Children with Cancer Fund (CWCF) is a small charity based in Polegate that aims to grant wishes to children who have/had cancer and their families across East Sussex, Brighton & Hove.d isolation.
